shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced price drops due to ongoing ETF outflows.
Federal Reserve's hawkish stance at June meeting signals potential rate hikes, negatively affecting risk assets.
Stalled US-Iran peace talks heightened geopolitical uncertainty, impacting Bitcoin's price.
Ethereum Foundation reduced staff by 20%, adding downward pressure on ETH price.
Tokenized Real-World Assets (RWAs) market cap surpassed $51 billion, indicating strong growth and institutional interest.
